regime_notes: Arc remains an exceptional launch-day activity regime: secondary reports based on Dune show about 7.76M transactions, ~$280K fees, >$410M Uniswap volume, ~$1B USDC transfers, ~$650M on-chain USDC and >700K new addresses. These are materially stronger than the earliest launch snapshots.

However, Gate now confirms an Arc-specific campaign running Sep 16-27 with zero-gas trading and up to 60K USDT of rewards tied to check-ins, cumulative trading-volume milestones, a top-30 volume leaderboard and new-user fee rebates. Those mechanics directly contaminate the framework's volume/user-growth signals. The nominal reward pool is far too small to explain all reported Arc turnover by itself, so this is a quality downgrade rather than rejection of the entire regime.

Arc-native ARGUS and TOLLY remain structurally rejected under prior contract/liquidity/concentration reviews. No newly observed Arc token passed the hard gate. UNI remains hold/no-add because Arc is only an incremental thesis leg and launch activity cannot yet be cleanly decomposed into independent discretionary users versus reward-driven churn.

DRV's V3-driven breakout continues to show forward price/volume persistence, but the previously recorded wallet-quality and governance/supply-admin gates remain unresolved. No chase and no paper entry.

ZEC remains strong above the latest $1,286.84 scale-add mark and is already at the 7.5% non-core cap. Seven-day net shielded inflow has slowed materially from the prior checkpoint, so price strength does not justify exceeding the cap; no trim condition is present.

HYPE received about $1.669M of Sep-16 ETF net inflow, partially offsetting the recent institutional-distribution concern, but the amount is not enough to establish a new accumulation regime or justify an add.

RWA discipline is unchanged: Circle states USYC, BUIDL and private-credit products can trade, lend and serve as collateral on Arc, but product availability and on-chain balances are not counted as verified secondary RWA trading or collateral utilization until those flows are measured separately.

Approximate paper NAV is $9,853.70 versus $9,755.53 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by $98.17 or about 100.6 bp. No current holding triggered a hard structural failure, thesis invalidation, trim or exit condition.
notes: Prospective hourly mark. Source-of-truth state and immutable trade ledger were read before decisions. The alert is a correction to Arc flow-quality attribution, not a paper-trade signal; state.json and trades.jsonl are unchanged.
